queries_run: Fortinet FTNT firewall refresh cycle demand durability 2026 2027

findings.claim: Fortinet 稱約65萬台防火牆2026年底到期、約35萬台低階機2027年到期；管理層稱換機週期延續至少4-6季；結構上2027批量較小且低價
findings.source: Nasdaq/Zacks: Will Fortinet's Firewall Upgrade Cycle Continue to Power Top-Line Growth?

findings.claim: Q2 2026 財報會議：FY2026營收指引上調至80.2-81.8億美元，管理層稱出現更廣泛的基礎設施替換機會而非僅傳統換機
findings.source: Chartmill: FTNT Q2 Earnings Call Highlights SASE Firewall Growth
